actions.d: Make one attack. With an [[Unarmed Strike]], choose **Damage** ({unarmed}), [[Grapple]] (DC {dc}), or [[Shove]] (DC {dc}, push 5 ft or knock [[Prone]]). Grappler lets you use Damage and Grapple on the same hit. Grappling needs one free hand.

Hold the Celurit in one hand and keep the other free. Turn 1: [[Unarmed Strike]] with the free hand. On a hit, Grappler deals {unarmed} damage and forces a [[Grapple]] save (DC {dc}). With [[Action Surge]], follow up with the Celurit at [[Advantage]]. Later turns: Celurit attacks with Advantage while the target stays [[Grappled]], and Savage Attacker rerolls one weapon damage roll per turn. If the Grapple save succeeds, punch again next turn.

For targets you can't Grapple, such as any Banaspati. Holding a Dagger and a Celurit, you make the extra [[Light]] attack as part of the [[Attack]] action instead of as a [[Bonus Action]] ([[Nick]]). The extra attack deals 1d8 with no ability modifier. Both hands are full, so you can't Grapple.
Take one additional action this turn, except the Magic action.
Stabilize a creature at 0 Hit Points, or end [[Bleeding]] with no check.

actions.n: Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Influence, Ready, Search, Study

actions.d: When a creature you can see leaves your reach, make one melee attack against it, including an [[Unarmed Strike]].
When you fail an ability check, add 1d10. If it still fails, the use isn't expended.
You can release a creature Grappled by you at any time. The creature escapes with a DC {dc} Strength ([[Athletics]]) or Dexterity ([[Acrobatics]]) check as an action. See [[Grappled]].

items.d: You have [[Darkvision]] with a range of 30 feet.
You gain an Origin feat of your choice. You chose **Tavern Brawler**.
You have [[Advantage]] on saving throws you make to avoid or end the [[Frightened]] condition.
You have [[Advantage]] on any D20 Test you make to discern the use of technology that you can see.
While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to [[Armor Class]].

As a [[Bonus Action]], you regain [[Hit Points]] equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level. You have 3 uses at Fighter 4. You regain one expended use when you finish a [[Short Rest]], and all expended uses when you finish a [[Long Rest]].

You can use the mastery properties of four kinds of weapons: [[Dagger]] ([[Nick]]), [[Sickle]] ([[Nick]]), [[Javelin]] ([[Slow]]), and [[Shortbow]] ([[Vex]]). Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can swap one of these choices for another Simple or Martial weapon.
On your turn, you can take one additional action, except the [[Magic]] action. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.
When you fail an ability check, you can expend a use of Second Wind to roll 1d10 and add the number rolled to the check. If the check still fails, the use of Second Wind isn't expended.
You gain proficiency in the [[Medicine]] skill.
When you roll damage for your [[Unarmed Strike]], you can roll 1d6 instead of the normal damage. If you aren't holding a Shield, the die is a d8 instead.
When you deal damage with a [[Dagger]], [[Sickle]], or Shortsword, you can use the same damage die you use for your Unarmed Strike.

features.next: Fighter level 7 unlocks Martial Stances (Offensive Stance and Defensive Stance).

items.d: Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target. An Unarmed Strike isn't a weapon, so this feat doesn't apply to it.

**Enhanced Unarmed Strike.** When you hit with your Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage. Pencak Silat's Unarmed Combatant gives a bigger die (1d8), so Yudhi uses that. **Damage Rerolls.** Whenever you roll a damage die for your [[Unarmed Strike]], you can reroll the die if it rolls a 1, and you must use the new roll. **Improvised Weaponry.** You have proficiency with improvised weapons. **Push.** When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can deal damage to the target and also push it 5 feet away from you. You can use this benefit only once per turn.

**Ability Score Increase.** Your Strength increases by 1. **Punch and Grab.** When you hit a creature with an [[Unarmed Strike]] as part of the [[Attack]] action on your turn, you can use both the Damage and the [[Grapple]] option. You can use this benefit only once per turn. **Attack Advantage.** You have [[Advantage]] on attack rolls against a creature [[Grappled]] by you. **Fast Wrestler.** You don't have to spend extra movement to move a creature Grappled by you if the creature is your size or smaller.
Skills: [[Athletics]] and [[Intimidation]]. Tool: one kind of Gaming Set ([[Dice Set]]).
Option A: [[Spear]], [[Shortbow]], 20 [[Arrows]], Gaming Set, [[Healer's Kit]], [[Quiver]], [[Traveler's Clothes]], 14 GP.
